Botryllus

The

four

although
some
colonies
overwinter
and
may

therefore

long

The
mature

consists
of

many
as
five

or

feeding

8-20

sharing

excurrent

Each
zooid
is
hermaphroditic ,
containing
both
testes
and
ovaries ,

own

The
vascular

blind

as
ampullae ,

present

edges

the
colony .
Botryllus

time

become

morphologically
indistinguishable
due

the
movement
of
pigment
cells
between

the
two
colonies .
The
product
of
such
a
fusion
is
termed
a
chimera .
